issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

format.description:
Format that extracted images should be saved in. The full list of supported formats can be
found [here](https://pillow.readthedocs.io/en/latest/handbook/image-file-formats.html).

dpi.description:
The number of pixels per inch in the generated images. A higher value will increase the image resolution, but will
also increase the output image size. Normally, 300dpi is needed for a sharp image.

imageHeight.description: Target height to resize all the images to

imageWidth.description: Target width to resize all the images to

resizeImages.description:
Whether to resize images to target dimensions.
If true, images are resized using imageHeight/imageWidth and maintainAspectRatio settings.
If false (default), images keep their original dimensions from PDF rendering (based on DPI).
Set to false when you want to preserve original PDF dimensions without standardization.

maintainAspectRatio.description:
Whether to maintain aspect ratio when resizing images.
If true, images are scaled to fit within target dimensions and padded with white.
If false (default), images are stretched to exact target dimensions.
Set to true when your project has PDFs with varying aspect ratios.

targets.description: A list of symbol types to be detected

thresholds.description: Probability thresholds for each symbol type

modelFileRelativePath.description: Relative path that contains the h5 model files for building {@link DiagramParsingPipeline#symbolDetectionPipe}.

featureSetName.description: The default name of the {@link Feature.Set} that will be used by {@link DiagramParsingMlModel}s.

modelId.description:
The id for the model to be used for the parsing workflow.
If no or invalid Id is set, then a default {@link DiagramParsingMlModel} will be used.
